question: Can Analytics share Dataset Y with Vendor X?
explanation: Vendor X is explicitly prohibited from receiving Dataset Y under VR-001 v2 effective June 2025 and DS-001-v4. The restriction applies across all departments and regions with no exceptions.

citations.text_excerpt: Vendor X (TechCorp Solutions Ltd) is prohibited from receiving any company data under any circumstances.
Vendor X is prohibited from receiving Dataset Y.

question: Can Finance share Dataset W with Vendor Z?
explanation: Under VR-003, Finance may authorize Vendor Z access to Dataset W for quarterly reporting with CFO approval. CFO approval documented. The exception in VR-003 explicitly permits Finance to grant Vendor Z access to Dataset W subject to CFO sign-off.

citations.text_excerpt: Finance department may approve Vendor Z access to Dataset W for quarterly reporting subject to CFO written approval.
The Finance department may share Dataset W with approved financial service vendors for audit and reporting purposes.

caveats: Requires CFO written approval before transfer

question: Can Analytics share Dataset Y with Vendor Y in EU?
explanation: Vendor Y is Tier 1 approved (VR-002). EU data requires SCC per REG-EU-001. Analytics sharing of Dataset Y requires CDO express written approval per DS-001-v5. With SCC in place and CDO written approval obtained, sharing is permitted.

citations.text_excerpt: Vendor Y (DataSync Partners AG) holds Tier 1 Approved Partner status.
Transfers to non-EEA vendors require SCCs or BCRs.
Sharing of Dataset Y with Tier 1 approved vendors requires CDO express written approval.

caveats: SCC must be executed before transfer

question: Can Engineering share Dataset Y with Vendor X for testing?
explanation: VR-001 prohibits Vendor X from receiving Dataset Y across ALL departments and use cases regardless of purpose. Engineering exceptions under DEPT-ENGINEERING-001 apply only to anonymized data with non-restricted vendors. The testing exception does not override the hard Vendor X prohibition.

citations.text_excerpt: Vendor X (TechCorp Solutions Ltd) is prohibited from receiving any company data under any circumstances. This restriction may not be waived.
All external data sharing by Engineering must use synthetic or anonymized datasets with approved non-restricted vendors only.

question: Can Analytics share Dataset Z with Vendor Y?
explanation: Vendor Y holds Tier 1 Approved Partner status (VR-002). Dataset Z may be shared with Tier 1 vendors without additional approval per DS-002-v2. No restrictions apply to the Analytics + Vendor Y + Dataset Z combination.

citations.text_excerpt: Vendor Y (DataSync Partners AG) holds Tier 1 Approved Partner status and may receive all categories of data subject to standard data sharing agreements.
Dataset Z may be shared with Tier 1 Approved Vendors without additional approval.

caveats: Standard data sharing agreement (DSA) must be in place
